senses.gloss:
शंकर a. (-रा, -री f.)
 [शं सुखं करोति कृ-अच्] Conferring happiness
 or prosperity, auspicious, propitious; भीताः शितशराभीताः शंकरं
 तत्र शंकरम् (मेनिरे) Ki. 15. 31.

—1 Dust, sweepings.
—2 The crackling of flames.

—1 Dust, sweepings.
—2 Crackling of flames.

—1 Commingling, mixture, intermixture; पत्रसंकर Ś. 2.
—2 Blending together, union.
—3 Confusion or mixture (of castes), unlawful intermarriage resulting
 in mixed castes; चित्रेषु वर्णसंकरः K.; संकरो नरकायैव कुलध्नानां
 कुलस्य च Bg. 1. 42; Ms. 10. 40.
—4 (In Rhet.) The combination of two or more dependent figures of
 speech in one and the same passage (opp. संसृष्टि where the figures
 are independent); अविश्रान्तिजुषामात्मन्यङ्गाङ्गित्वे तु संकरः K. P. 10;
 or अङ्गाङ्गित्वेऽलंकृतीनां तद्वदेकाश्रयस्थितौ । संदिग्धत्वे च
 भवति संकरस्त्रिविधः पुनः S. D. 757.
—5 The crackling of flames; जागर्त्येव हि दुष्टात्मा संकरेऽग्निरिवोत्थितः
 Mb. 12. 103. 12.
—6 Dust, sweepings.
—7 Dung.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकरज, संकरजात, संकरस्वेदः

शंकर + .{@-री@}
—1 N. of Pārvatī, wife of Śiva.
—2 Bengal madder.
—3 The Śamī tree.
.━{@Comp.@}: शंकराचार्यः, शंकरावासः, शंकरप्रियः, शंकरशुक्रम्
संकरी See संकारी.
संकारी A girl recently deflowered.

शंकर + -आचार्यः N. of a celebrated teacher of Vedānta philosophy and
 reviver of Brāhmanism.

शंकर + -आवासः
—1 the Kailāsa.
—2 camphor.
शंकर + -प्रियः the francoline partridge.
शंकर + -शुक्रम् quick-silver.

संकट a.
—1 Contracted, narrow, strait; संकटद्वारकाणि स्युरुच्छ्वासार्थं पुरस्य
 च Mb. 12. 69. 44.
—2 Impervious,
[]
 impassable.
—3 Full of, crowded with, beset with, hemmed in; संकटा ह्याहिताग्नीनां
 प्रत्यवायैर्गृहस्थता Mv. 4. 33; विषमशिलासंकटस्खलितवेगः V. 2. 8; U. 1. 8.
—4 Pressed, made thin (कृशीकृत); कृतप्रतिकृतैश्चित्रैबाहुभिश्च सुसंकटैः Mb. 4. 13. 27.
—5 Dangerous, critical.

संकट + .{@-टम्@}
—1 A narrow passage, defile, pass.
—2 A difficulty, strait, risk, peril, danger; संकटेष्वविषण्णधीः
 K.; संकटे हि परीक्ष्यन्ते प्राज्ञाः शूराश्च संगरे Ks. 31. 93.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकटचतुर्थी, संकटमुख
संकट + -चतुर्थी N. of the fourth day in the dark half of श्रावण.
संकट + -मुख a. narrow-mouthed.

संकथ् €10 U.
—1 To talk together, converse.
—2 To narrate, relate.
—3 To explain.
संकथनम् Narration.

—1 Conversation, talk.
—2 Accordance, agreement.

संकर्षम् N. given to Adhyāyas 13-16 of जैमिनिʼs पूर्वमीमांसासूत्र.
 It is also called the संकर्षकाण्ड; स्विष्टकृद्विकारश्च वनस्पतिरिति
 संकर्षे वक्ष्यते ŚB. on MS. 10. 4. 32.

संकल् €10 U.
—1 To add or sum up.
—2 To heap, accumulate, collect.
—3 To deem, regard; तरुच्छिद्रप्रोतान् विसमिति करी संकलयति K. P. 10.
—4 To grasp, seize, lay hold of.
—5 To drive away, put to flight, rout.
—6 To perform the funeral honours to a dead person.

—1 Accumulation, collection.
—2 Addition.

संकलनम्, -ना
—1 The act of heaping together.
—2 Contact, junction.
—3 Collision.
—4 Blending, twining.
—5 Addition (in math.).

संकालनम् Burning a corpse, funeral ceremony; न तु संकालनं
 राज्ञो विना पुत्रेण मन्त्रिणः Rām. 2. 66. 15.

संकलनम्, -ना
—1 The act of heaping together.
—2 Contact, junction.
—3 Collision.
—4 Blending, twining.
—5 Addition (in math.).

संकलित p. p.
—1 Heaped up, piled up, collected.
—2 Blended together, intermixed.
—3 Seized, laid hold of.
—4 Added.
—5 Resumed, regained; Māl. 3.
संकलित + .{@-ता@} (In arith.) The first sum.

संकलित + .{@-तम्@} Addition.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकलितैक्यम्
संकलित + -ऐक्यम् the sum of the terms of an arithmetical progression.
संकलितिन् a. One who has made an addition.
संकष्टम् Distress, trouble (used in comp.); see संकट.

संकसुक a.
—1 Unsteady, fickle, changeable, inconstant.
—2 Uncertain, doubtful.
—3 Bad, wicked.
—4 Weak, feeble.

संकाश a.
—1 Like, similar, resembling (at the end of comp.); अग्नि˚, हिरण्य˚;
 विपत्तिं घोरसंकाशां क्रुद्धादग्निशिखामिव
[]
 Rām. 7. 81. 4.
—2 Near, close, at hand.
संकिलः A fire-brand, burning torch.

संकुच् €1. €6 P.
—1 To become contracted, shrink.
—2 To close, shut (as a flower).
—3 To contract, compress. ━Caus. To contract, narrow.

संकुचित p. p.
—1 Contracted, abridged; लङ्कापतेः संकुचितं यशो यत् Vikr. 1. 27.
—2 Shrunk, wrinkled; गात्रं संकुचितं गतिर्विगलिता दन्ताश्च नाशं
 गताः Pt. 4. 78.
—3 Closed, shut.
—4 Covering.

—1 Contraction, shrinking up.
—2 Abridgment, diminution, compression.
—3 Terror, fear.
—4 Shutting up, closing.
—5 Binding.
—6 Crouching down, humbling oneʼs self; त्वयेयं पृथिवी लब्धा न संकोचेन
 चाप्युत Mb. 12. 14. 18.
—7 A kind of skate-fish.

संकोचः + .{@-चम्@} Saffron.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकोचपिशुनम्
संकोचः + -पिशुनम् saffron.
संकोचनम् Contraction.
संकोचनम् + .{@-नी@} The sensitive plant (Mar. लाजाळू).

संकुल a.
—1 Confused.
—2 Thronged with, crowded or filled with, full of; नक्षत्रताराग्रहसंकुलापि
 ज्योतिष्मती चन्द्रमसैव रात्रिः R. 6. 22; Māl. 1. 2.
—3 Disordered, perplexed; अन्योन्यप्रतिघातसंकुलचलत्कल्लोलकोलाहलैः U. 2. 30.
—4 Inconsistent.
—5 Thick, dense (as smoke). —6 Violent, intense.

संकुल + .{@-लम्@}
—1 A crowd, mob, throng, collection, swarm, flock; महतः पौरजनस्य
 संकुलेन विघटितायां तस्यामागतोऽस्मि Māl. 1; Pt. 1. 7.
—2 A confused fight, melee; तस्मिंस्तथा संकुले वर्तमाने Mb. 3. 134. 22.
—3 An inconsistent or contradictory speech; e. g. यावज्जीवमहं
 मौनी ब्रह्मचारी च मे पिता । माता तु मम वन्ध्यैव पुत्रहीनः पितामहः ॥.
—4 Distress, destruction (नाश); प्राविशत् संकुलं तत्र शलभा
 इव पावकम् Rām. 7. 19. 16.
संकूजितम् The cry of the Cakravāka.

सांकूजितम् Loud commingled twittering; सांकूजितं पक्षिगणः करोति
 Rām. Ch. 6. 21.

संकृ €8 U. (संकरोति-संकुरुते)
—1 To commit; ये पक्षापरपक्षदोषसहिताः पापानि संकुर्वते Mk. 9. 4.
—2 To manufacture, prepare.
—3 To do, perform in general.

संकॄ €6 P.
—1 To mix, commingle or mix together; न संकिरेत्तदन्नं च ततः पूयेत
 ब्राह्मणः Mb. 13. 136. 13.
—2 To scatter about, diffuse.
—3 To fill.

संकृष् €1 P.
—1 To drag along or away.
—2 To contract. —3 To tighten, tie fast.

—1 The act of drawing together, contracting; (सात्वती) या द्रष्टृदृश्ययोः
 संकर्षणम् Bhāg. 5. 25. 1.
—2 Attracting.
—3 Ploughing, furrowing.
—4 Shortening.

संकर्षणम् + .{@-णः@}
—1 N. of Balarāma; असियुद्धे गदायुद्धे रथयुद्धे च पाण्डवः । संकर्षणादशिक्षद्वै
 शश्वच्छिक्षां वृकोदरः ॥ Mb. 1. 139. 4; संकर्षणात्तु गर्भस्य स
 हि संकर्षणो युवा Hariv.
—2 N. of the great serpent Śeṣa; पातालतलमारभ्य संकर्षणमुखानलः
 Bhāg. 11. 3. 10.
—3 The destructor of the world; क्षये संकर्षणं प्रोक्तं तमुपास्यमुपास्महे
 Mb. 12. 47. 32.
—4 Egotism (अहंकार); सोऽग्रजं सर्वभूतानां संकर्षणमकल्पयत्
 Mb. 12. 207. 10.

संकरः + -ज, -जात a. born from a mixed caste; वृथासंकरजातानां
 … … निवर्तेतोदकक्रिया Ms. 5. 89.

संकरः + -ज, -जात a. born from a mixed caste; वृथासंकरजातानां
 … … निवर्तेतोदकक्रिया Ms. 5. 89.
संकरः + -स्वेदः a particular sudorific treatment.

संकरीकरणम् Illegality, sin; खराश्वोष्ट्रमृगेभानामजाविकवधस्तथा ।
 संकरीकरणं ज्ञेयं मीनाहिमहिषस्य च ॥ Ms. 11. 68.

संकारिन् a.
—1 Confused, intermixed.
—2 Arising from intermixture of castes.

संकीर्ण p. p.
—1 Mixed together, intermingled.
—2 Confused, miscellaneous.
—3 Shattered, spread, crowded.
—4 Indistinct.
—5 In rut, intoxicated; मदोद्धतस्य नृपतेः संकीर्णस्येव दन्तिनः …
 नेतारः खलु वाच्यताम् H. 4. 17.
—6 Of mixed caste, of impure origin.
—7 Impure, adulterated; तस्मात् संकीर्णवृत्तेषु वासो मम न रोचते Mb. 1. 79. 9.
—8 Narrow, contracted.

संकीर्ण + .{@-र्णा@} A kind of riddle; सा भवेदुभयच्छन्ना यस्यामुभयगोपनम् ।
 संकीर्णा नाम सा यस्यां नानालक्षणसंकरः ॥ Kāv. 3. 105.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकीर्णजाति, संकीर्णयोनि, संकीर्णयुद्धम्

संकीर्ण + .{@-र्णः@}
—1 A man of a mixed caste.
—2 A mixed note or mode.
—3 An elephant in rut, an intoxicated elephant; name of the fourth caste
 of elephants; Mātaṅga L. 1. 26, 30.
संकीर्ण + .{@-र्णम्@} A difficulty.

संकीर्ण + -जाति, -योनि a. of mixed birth, of a mongrel breed (as a mule);
 impure through illegal intermarriage; संकीर्णयोनयो ये तु प्रतिलोमानुलोमजाः Ms. 10. 25.

संकीर्ण + -जाति, -योनि a. of mixed birth, of a mongrel breed (as a mule);
 impure through illegal intermarriage; संकीर्णयोनयो ये तु प्रतिलोमानुलोमजाः Ms. 10. 25.
संकीर्ण + -युद्धम् a confused fight, melee.

संकॄत् €10 U.
—1 To recite.
—2 To praise, celebrate, glorify.
—3 To tell, mention.
—4 To proclaim, announce.

संकीर्तनम्, -ना
—1 Praising, applauding, extolling.
—2 Glorification (of a deity).
—3 Repeating the name of a deity as a pious or devotional act.

संकीर्तनम्, -ना
—1 Praising, applauding, extolling.
—2 Glorification (of a deity).
—3 Repeating the name of a deity as a pious or devotional act.

संकॢप् €1 Ā. To wish or long for. ━Caus.
—1 To resolve, determine, settle.
—2 To intend, aim at, purpose; संकल्पितार्थे विवृतात्मशक्तिमाखण्डलः
 काममिदं बभाषे Ku. 3. 11.
—3 To arrange or connect together.
—4 To fix, assign, allot.
—5 To consecrate, dedicate.
—6 To imagine, fancy.
—7 To think about, ponder, reflect; देवेभ्य आगायद्यत् कल्याणं संकल्पयति तदात्मने Bṛ. Up. 1. 3. 6.
—8 To perform obsequies.

—1 Will, volition, mental resolve; कामः संकल्पो विचिकित्सा … Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 3;
 कः कामः संकल्पः Dk.
—2 Purpose, aim, intention, determination.
—3 Wish, desire; संकल्पमात्रोदितसिद्धयस्ते R. 14. 17.
—4 Thought, idea, reflection, fancy, imagination; तत्संकल्पोपहितजडिम
 स्तम्भमभ्येति गात्रम् Māl. 1. 35; वृथैव संकल्पशतैरजस्रमनङ्ग
 नीतोऽसि मया विवृद्धिम् Ś. 3. 5 (v. l.); प्रियासंनिहितैवेयं संकल्पस्थापिता
 पुरः Nāg. 2. 9.
—5 The mind, heart; शान्तसंकल्पः सुमना यथा स्यात् Kaṭh. 1. 10;
 संकल्पनिर्वृतिषु संस्तुत एष दासः Māl. 7. 2.
—6 A solemn vow to perform an observance.
—7 Expectation of advantage from a holy voluntary act.
—8 Consideration, reflection.
—9 A declaration made by a widow at the time of burning herself with her husband.
.━{@Comp.@}: संकल्पात्मक, संकल्पज, संकल्पजः, संकल्पजन्मन्, संकल्पप्रभव, संकल्पमूल, संकल्पसंभव, संकल्परूप

संकल्पः + -आत्मक a.
—1 willing, resolving.
—2 consisting of thought only, imaginary.

संकल्पः + -ज a. produced from self-will, desire or idea of advantage;
 व्रतानि यमधर्माश्च सर्वे संकल्पजाः स्मृताः Ms. 2. 3.

संकल्पः + -प्रभव a. born from desire (an epithet of Madana); कामिनां
 बहुमन्तव्यं संकल्पप्रभवोदयम् Bhāg. 8. 12. 16.

संकल्पः + -मूल, -संभव a. based on some idea or desire; संकल्पमूलः
 कामो वै यज्ञाः संकल्पसंभवाः Ms. 2. 3.

संकल्पः + -मूल, -संभव a. based on some idea or desire; संकल्पमूलः
 कामो वै यज्ञाः संकल्पसंभवाः Ms. 2. 3.

संकल्पः + -रूप a.
—1 volitional.
—2 conformable to will.
संकल्पनम् Purpose, wish, desire.

संकल्पित a.
—1 Wished for, intended, aimed at.
—2 Determined, resolved upon; संकल्पितं प्रथममेव मया तवार्थे भर्तारमात्मसदृशं
 सुकृतैर्गता त्वम् Ś. 4. 13.
—3 Imagined, fancied.

संकॢप्त p. p.
—1 Contrived, prepared.
—2 Desired, wished.

—1 Will, volition.
—2 Thought, fancy.

—1 An intimation, allusion.
—2 A sign, gesture, hint; Mu. 1.
—3 An indicatory sign, mark, token.
—4 Agreement, convention; संकेतो गृह्यते जातौ गुणद्रव्यक्रियासु च S. D. 12.
—5 Engagement, appointment, assignation (made by a mistress or lover);
 नामसमेतं कृतसंकेतं वादयते मृदु वेणुम् Gīt. 5.
—6 A place of meeting (for lovers), rendezvous; सा स्वैरिण्येकदा कान्तं
 संकेतम् उपनेष्यति Bhāg. 11. 8. 23; कान्तार्थिनी तु या याति संकेतं
 साभिसारिका Ak.
—7 Condition, provision.
—8 A short explanatory rule (in gram.).

संकेतः + -गृहम्, -निकेतनम्, -स्थानम् a place of appointment or assignation, rendezvous.
संकेतः + -वाक्यम् watchword.

—1 Agreement, convention.
—2 Appointment, assignation.
—3 Rendezvous.
—4 A lover or mistress who makes an appointment; संकेतके चिरयति
 प्रवरो विनोदः Mk. 3. 3.

—1 Appointment, agreement.
—2 A rendezvous.

संकेतयति Den. P.
—1 To agree upon, appoint.
—2 To fix by convention, lay down conventionally.
—3 To invite, call.
—4 To give a hint.

संकेतित a.
—1 Agreed upon, fixed by convention; साक्षात् संकेतितं योऽर्थमभिधत्ते
 स वाचकः K. P. 2.
—2 Invited, called.

—1 War, battle; एते कौरव संक्रन्दे शैनेयं पर्यवाकिरन् Mb. 7. 172. 13.
—2 Sounding together (कोलाहल); तस्मिन् महति संक्रन्दे राजा दुर्योधनस्तदा ।

—4 Means of extracting Soma (अभिषवण); तस्मिञ्जातः सोमसंक्रन्दमध्ये Mb. 7. 23. 29.

 Rām. Ch. 2. 67.
संक्रन्दनः + .{@-नम्@} War, battle.

—1 To come or meet together.
—2 To traverse, cross, go or pass through.
—3 To approach, go.

—6 To be present at, attend.
—7 To surmount. ━Caus.

—2 To devolve, consign, entrust; ब्राह्मणसंक्रमिताक्षरेण पितामहेन
 V. 3; Ku. 6. 78.
—3 To deliver, hand over.
—4 To convey, lead towards.
—5 To take possession of.
—6 To promise mutual assistance.

—1 Concurrence, going together.
